import bpy, subprocess, json, sys
mods=['rasterio','osgeo','pyproj','numpy']
print('BLENDER_PY='+sys.executable)
for m in mods:
    try:
        mod=__import__(m); print('BLENDER_'+m+'=YES '+str(getattr(mod,'__version__','')))
    except Exception as e: print('BLENDER_'+m+'=NO '+type(e).__name__)
cp=subprocess.run(['python','-c',"import importlib.util, json; mods=['rasterio','osgeo','pyproj','numpy']; print(json.dumps({m: bool(importlib.util.find_spec(m)) for m in mods}))"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print('SYSTEM_PY_RC='+str(cp.returncode))
print('SYSTEM_PY='+cp.stdout.strip())
print('SYSTEM_ERR='+cp.stderr.strip())
print('GEO_STACK_CHECK_OK')
